hook: Weekly recap: how mining difficulty really works.

scenes.narration: The target is a 256-bit number. A hash must be at or below it.
The lower the target, the harder it is to generate a block.
Every two thousand sixteen blocks it adjusts, never by more than a factor of four.

cta: Is difficulty clear now? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Weekly Recap: Target and Difficulty
description_body: The target, why lower is harder and how it adjusts every 2,016 blocks.
